output.review_comment: Request changes: (1) Provide evidence that all tests pass after these changes. (2) Explain what the test suite requires and why the specification/docstring changed from "holidays used exactly as given" to "holidays observed on nearby weekdays." (3) Add a PR description explaining the changes. (4) Show analysis of the test cases to verify the implementation matches requirements. The docstring change suggests either the tests require different behavior (needs verification) or the implementation is incorrect (needs correction).
